intro.h2: A Branding Agency Wolverhampton Businesses Can Build On
paras: DigiRanx Pro is a branding agency Wolverhampton businesses can turn to when they want to look established from day one. Your brand is how people remember you. It is the logo on your van, the colours on your website, the tone of your emails and the feeling customers have after dealing with you. We create logos, colour palettes, typography and brand guidelines that hold all of that together, online and in print.

Many businesses start with a logo made in a hurry, then add colours and fonts as they go. Over time the website, social profiles, signage and paperwork drift apart, and the business looks less polished than it really is. A clear brand identity fixes that. It gives you a single set of rules that everyone, from your own team to your printer and web designer, can follow without guessing.

Our branding work starts with discovery, not drawing. We learn your story, your values and who your customers are, then look at how competitors present themselves. That understanding shapes the logo concepts we create and the palette and type system we build around them. You review several directions, choose the one that fits, and we refine it until it feels right for your business and the people you serve.

We are a new studio based in Wolverhampton, working with start-ups, sole traders and growing companies across Birmingham, Walsall, Dudley, Telford and the wider UK. Whether you are launching a business, rebranding after a change of direction or refreshing a logo that has started to feel dated, we keep the process clear and the deliverables practical, with files ready for every use you will need.

why.h2: Why Choose Our Wolverhampton Branding Studio
why.lead: A brand should last for years, so the way it is created matters. Here is what sets our approach apart.

points.d: We begin by understanding your audience, values and position in the market. Design choices are then grounded in what your business needs to say, rather than passing trends, which helps your identity stay relevant long after launch.

Every logo project includes multiple concepts, each taking a different direction. Seeing genuine alternatives side by side makes it easier to decide what feels right, and our revision rounds let you refine the chosen route in detail.

We test your logo and colours at every size and on every surface, from a social media avatar to a shop sign. You receive colour and mono versions in all the file formats your suppliers are likely to ask for.

Once the project is paid, full copyright in your logo and brand assets transfers to you. There are no licensing fees or restrictions, so you are free to use, adapt and protect your brand however your business needs.

benefits.h2: Benefits of a Professional Brand Identity
benefits.lead: Good branding is an investment that keeps paying back every time a customer sees your name.

items.d: A distinctive logo and consistent colours help people remember you. When customers see your van, your post or your sign, they connect it to your business straight away, which builds familiarity over time.

A polished identity tells potential customers you take your business seriously. Even a new company can look established and dependable, which makes people more comfortable getting in touch, asking for a quote or buying.

Brand guidelines set clear rules for logos, colours, fonts and spacing. Your website, social media, stationery and signage all match, whoever produces them, so your business always presents one recognisable face.

With a ready-made social media kit, templates and stationery, creating new marketing becomes quicker. You spend less time deciding how things should look and more time getting your message in front of customers.

Discovery work shows how competitors in Wolverhampton and beyond present themselves. We use that to give your brand a clear, different look, so you are not lost among similar logos and colour schemes.

A well-built identity scales as you add services, staff or locations. New materials slot neatly into the existing system, so your brand stays coherent instead of becoming a collection of mismatched designs.

steps.h2: Our Branding Process Step by Step
steps.lead: Every branding project follows a clear sequence, moving from understanding your business to delivering a complete, usable identity.

items.d: We talk through your story, values, customers and goals, and review competitors in your market. On the Brand Book package this becomes a full brand strategy workshop that defines your positioning and personality.

Using the discovery insights, we design several logo concepts, each exploring a different direction. We present them with examples on real items such as business cards and social profiles, so you can judge them in context.
You choose a preferred concept and share your feedback. We work through the included revision rounds, adjusting shapes, spacing and details until the logo is clear, balanced and works at every size.
With the logo agreed, we build the supporting palette and font system. These are chosen to work on screens and in print, and to give enough variety for websites, documents and marketing materials.

Finally we deliver your logo files in every format, along with brand guidelines and any stationery or social media kit in your package. You leave with everything needed to apply the brand consistently.

faqs.a: Our Logo package is £299 for three logo concepts, three revision rounds and all file formats. Identity is £699 and adds a colour palette, typography, business card, letterhead, social media kit and mini brand guide. Brand Book is £1,299 for a full brand system with 40-page guidelines. Prices are one-off, in GBP and exclude VAT.

Yes. Full copyright transfers to you once the project is paid. You can use the logo on any material, trademark it if you wish and work with any supplier you choose. We do not charge licensing fees or place restrictions on how you use the brand we create for you.

faqs.q: Can You Refresh My Existing Logo?
faqs.a: Yes. A refresh keeps the recognition you have already built while modernising the look. We might simplify shapes, update the typeface or adjust colours so the logo works better on screens and at small sizes. It is often a smart choice for established businesses that do not want to start from scratch.

You receive your logo in all common formats, including vector files for print and signage, PNGs with transparent backgrounds for digital use, and both colour and mono versions. Larger packages add brand guidelines, stationery artwork and a social media kit with profile images, covers and post templates.

faqs.q: What Is Included in Brand Guidelines?
faqs.a: Brand guidelines explain how to use your logo, including clear space, minimum size and versions to avoid. They set out your colour values for print and screen, your fonts and how to apply them. The Brand Book package includes a detailed 40-page guide, while Identity includes a shorter mini brand guide.

faqs.q: Do You Work With Businesses Outside Wolverhampton?
faqs.a: Yes. As a branding agency based in Wolverhampton, we enjoy working with local clients, but we also support businesses across Birmingham, Walsall, Dudley, Telford and the wider UK. Discovery sessions and presentations work well over video calls, and every file is delivered digitally.
